author: EmuCore - Hub
title: PS2 Emulation for PlayStation 4: Frame-Rate Test
summary: Digital Foundry compares frame rates in Sony's PS2-on-PS4 emulation, showing how commercial compatibility can be evaluated beyond screenshots.
searchKeywords: PS2 Emulation for PlayStation 4: Frame-Rate Test

blocks.text: The short Digital Foundry test asks whether Sony's PlayStation 4 emulation runs selected PS2 software more smoothly than original hardware. Its frame-rate focus gives a measurable dimension to a commercial re-release that is often discussed only in terms of image resolution. A viewer can watch for sustained speed and drops during action rather than assuming that faster host hardware automatically produces a locked frame rate.

The clip dates from 2015 and measures the games and emulator build available then. It cannot characterize every PS2 title, later re-release or PCSX2 configuration. Frame rate also does not by itself prove accurate input, audio, effects or timing. For a fair comparison, use the same game region and scene and account for display output and capture method. The video is valuable as a concise example of performance analysis with a defined target, not a ranking of all PS2 emulators.
